text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wow～ The cafeteria's crowded as usual…! 
Just the teensiest bit late and there's
already nowhere to sit…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Oh! There's a couple of open seats over
there! 
Yay. Now that's what I call a miracle. ♪)

text_block_list.name: Double Miracle
text_block_list.text: …Oh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Uh… Hehe. 
Wanna sit together, Miracle-chan?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haha… If you're OK with it, sure. 
Thanks for asking, Hishi Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Phew～ What a meal～♪ 
…Hang on, that flyer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's for the Town Chorus Fest thing,
right? 
I just happened to see it on the bulletin
board today～

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
…! 
Hishi Miracle… Would you maybe be
interested?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haha, well, I am interested, buuuut,
it's more about the prize.
Tickets for an all-expenses-paid luxury
group trip! Talk about a dream vacation,
you know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, uh,
I know it's just a little thing set up by
the shopping district,
but I'm not thinking anything crazy like "Oh,
I might actually be able to win this"! I'm not,
but…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's just,
it was Summer Walk season not too long ago,
right? 
Everyone was out doing mini-vacations,
recreation, stuff like that, but——

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
All I did was chill out in my room and go
total relaxo mode… 
It's kinda too late now,
but I'm getting the itch to go on a trip,
y'know…?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
…Wait, I sound like a total bum right now,
don't I!? 
Hahaha, sorry about that～

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, not at all. Don't worry. 
…Right, the prize…!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh? …Uh, Miracle-chan?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Right. …If you're okay with it,
let's try and win together. 
Please——!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
…won't you perform with me at the Town Chorus
Fest…?

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Good thing your fever went down, huh,
Kei-chan? But if you start feeling worse,
remember to say something.
Even though I know you want to stay and
listen.

text_block_list.name: Little Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm okay. 
…Hey.
Their singing… It's really beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Little Miracle
text_block_list.text:
They look like they're having so much fun…
Hehe. 
I'm starting to having fun too!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
…Ever since then, I've always remembered. 
The singing that warmed my heart——

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(If I remember right,
Miracle-chan used to be in the hospital most
of the time.
So this is one of her happy memories from
that time…)

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The kids who are hospitalized there are
going to come watch the Chorus Fest,
apparently.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's why… If I can, this time,
I want to be the one to pass that warm
singing on to them.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
But because it's a "choir" fest,
I exactly can't do it by myself, so… 
Oh, um! Sorry.
It's totally OK if you don't want to.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no,
it's okay! No problem at all. Nope. 
So, uh… Yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(…Okay,
to be honest?
This conversation's way heavier than I
thought it'd be! But still!
I've at least got to do what I can!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
…S-so, the prize trip!
It's got free admission to the nearby leisure
center, a hotel with a great view,
and even a full-course luxury seafood
dinner!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I wanna go! I wanna eat!
I wanna chill oooouut!! 
……………So, y'know…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Let's do our best and win this thing,
Miracle-chan!!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hishi Miracle…

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
——Yeah. 
Yeah… Thanks. Let's do our best…!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
So I see we are forming a choir with the
five of us.
Then let us begin without further delay.
In fact let us finish everything between
practice and performance right here and
now.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
But before we begin.
Having two Miracles is way too confusing so
while we are here you will be Kei-chan and
you will be Kuu-chan. Agreed? Agreed.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
……Do not simply take it all in stride!! 
Not the situation, not us,
and certainly not these nicknames!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Aha… hahaha… Uhhhhh, for now, how about… 
Thanks for having us, Miracle-senpai… 
…I guess?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
G-good to have you… So, um…? 
Hishi Miracle, what's going on here…?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hang on. I'm as totally lost as you are… 
First things first, I invited Dantsu-chan!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I figured it'd be better to have a bit of
a bigger group… 
Dantsu-chan's the nicest roommate I could
ever ask for,
so I thought maybe she'd be willing to join us.
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you don't need to talk me up like that.
You're the nice roommate here,
Mirako-senpai. Besides,
being in a choir with everyone sounds like
a lot of fun!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, gee, you're such a good, good girl～ 
…Anyway. Everything up to that makes sense,
but… 
What's the deal with Durandal-chan and Light
O-chan?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
We were informed through conversation with
Dantsu-san while cleaning the classroom.
It is only natural for a knight to jump at
the opportunity to perform such a noble task
for the youth.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
So basically she thought it seemed like a
pretty good thing to do and sounded very
fun and so she tagged along.
I did too by the way.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I would prefer if you did not equate us!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
L- looks like we've added some strong
personalities to the group… Sorry for letting
them in without asking, Miracle-chan…

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Don't worry! I was just thinking,
this going to be a really fun group,
that's all.
Makes me want to tell the kids right away.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu, Light O,
Durandal. Thank you all for coming. 
I'd love to be in the Chorus Fest with all
of you.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes very good. You can count on me lots,
Kei-chan. 
You too Kuu-chan.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I guess we're actually doing the nickname
thing…?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Anyway.
Without further ado the choir "Team Miraclez"
sets their sights on the Chorus Fest!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Oh. I guess that's our group name now…?
